title: Coefficient norms of dt-slices and horizontal slices of covectors, and |α| ≤ √(P^n)·‖α‖ (supplied step 1, (C1)–(C3))
statement: Let ι(v) := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ v)) for v ∈ ℝ^m, e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∈ ℝ^{m+1}, |γ| := covectorEuclideanNorm γ (the Euclidean norm of the coefficients γ(b_{I 0}, …) over strictly increasing coordinate tuples I, b = EuclideanSpace.basisFun) and ‖γ‖ the operator norm of a covector γ. (C1) For all m, k ∈ ℕ, every (k+1)-covector γ on ℝ^{m+1} and every k-covector γ′ on ℝ^m with γ′(v) = γ(Fin.cons e₀ (fun i => ι(v i))) for all v : Fin k → ℝ^m: |γ′| ≤ |γ|. (C2) For all m, q ∈ ℕ, every q-covector γ on ℝ^{m+1} and every q-covector γ′ on ℝ^m with γ′(v) = γ(fun i => ι(v i)) for all v : Fin q → ℝ^m: |γ′| ≤ |γ|. (C3) For all P, n ∈ ℕ and every n-covector α on ℝ^P: |α| ≤ √(P^n)·‖α‖.
lean_statement: (∀ (m k : ℕ) (γ : Covector (Eucl (m + 1)) (k + 1)) (γ' : Covector (Eucl m) k), (∀ v : Fin k → Eucl m, γ' v = γ (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → covectorEuclideanNorm γ' ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm γ) ∧ (∀ (m q : ℕ) (γ : Covector (Eucl (m + 1)) q) (γ' : Covector (Eucl m) q), (∀ v : Fin q → Eucl m, γ' v = γ (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → covectorEuclideanNorm γ' ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm γ) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (α : Covector (Eucl P) n), covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ Real.sqrt ((P : ℝ) ^ n) * ‖α‖)
